description: Ministry of Mass Media - Revision of Local Postage - 2022
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to postal rules and regulations under the Post Office Ordinance. It involves modifications to legal frameworks and regulatory requirements for postal services, including changes to fee structures and service parameters. While it mentions a minister (Dr. Bandula Gunawardana), it does so only in the context of his authority to make these rules under existing legislation, and does not include any detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes. The core content is purely regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
